description:
Source issue: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834
Parent contract: zaq-zqq (read before implementation).

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
lib/zaq/agent/tools/accounts/history.ex and test/zaq/agent/tools/accounts/history_test.exs. message_output/1 and flatten_messages/1 must forward common domain-projected author and timestamp/provenance fields. Retain raw content, current grouping/order/limits and existing inserted_at semantics. Update output schema descriptions/examples. No directory queries, owner-based inference, text-header rendering or independent fallback logic inside the Action.
Tests to add before implementation: nested conversations[].messages[] and flat messages[] field parity, multi-participant/same-name messages, missing Person, provider time versus recorded time, aliases, empty results, current requester/skip_permissions behavior, stable metadata counts and chronological order. Explicitly replace the old exact role/content-only flat-list expectation only under recorded approval.
Branches/paths validated: chat/workflow trusted actors, privileged explicit scope, unauthorized/nil actors, data-layer failure, finite message pages and summary queries. Avoid re-resolving author metadata merely to calculate counts.
Mocking plan: real directory and Conversations reads; no domain mocks.
Documentations to update: History Action schema/examples/moduledoc and docs/services/agent.md recall-tool output contract.
Action reuse assessment: extend existing accounts.fetch_history Action; Conversations owns lookup/projection. Preserve tool key, parameters, permissions and workflow eligibility; output fields are additive. No new Action or parallel search operation.
Acceptance: every returned message representation includes the same domain-provided author/time while content remains unchanged.
title: [#834] Preserve attribution and timestamps in both history search representations
